name: iw7
title: Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare (IW7)
note: Addresses from the decrypted iw7_ship.exe, flattened (file offset == RVA); named with iw7-mod's and x64-zt's symbol tables (they match this build) and read off the loaders. Two loader families exist; the default path (flag 0x53e7340 = 0 in the exe) is DB_LoadXFile tail 0xa7c940 -> asset loop 0xa7cb20 -> Load_XAsset 0xa159f0 -> switch 0xa15a40. The other family (0xa7cd80/0xa71fe0/0xa71f90/0xa72090) is not used here.

asset_dispatch.note: varXAsset = &list[i]; Load_XAsset(false): Load_Stream(16) then the type switch 0xa15a40

stream.markers_note: inline string slots and asset headers are -2 in every zone read so far; -1 still to confirm
stream.backref_note: resolve 0x9e9a20: block << 32 | offset + 1; every back reference of the 699 recorded zones names block 8
stream.pointer_ifs_note: the Ptr loaders (88 tables) are transcribed as IF chains on their own field, one arm per marker: a taken arm is the pointer followed (link, and -3's slot)

resident_slot.marker_note: the Ptr loaders (0xa17a80) call insert_ptr only for -3: -1 and -2 load without a slot

zone_load.note: the default DB_LoadXFile tail 0xa7c940: file_read of the 0x28-byte XAssetList into the caller's static (var_asset_list), under push(8) the script strings and XGlobals load, pop; under push(8) the asset array is allocated (0x9e9a00) and read, then the loop 0xa7cb20
zone_load.prefix_table_note: the XGlobals' reader table (loader 0xa16ba0's struct reader), walked by Games/IW7/ZoneFormat.cpp for the asset array's position

crt_note: IAT thunks the emulator performs itself (their DLLs are not in the dump): rva -> memset/memcpy/...
rva_note: file_read = DB_ReadXFile(dst, n). Load_Stream(flag, dst, size) memsets instead when the current block is 6. load_string reads one byte at a time through file_read (stream.byte_strings). alloc = DB_AllocStreamPos(7) returning the cursor; the aligned alloc itself is 0xa0a80(align-1). insert_ptr reserves 8 bytes in block 8. resolve: back reference (block << 32 | off + 1).
inert_base_note: 0x3b9020 copies fields out of an asset another pointer names (bounds of a referenced model): it reads no stream, but has no .pdata entry (anti-tamper chunking), so the reach rule cannot skip it
extra_readers_note: the default DB_LoadXFile tail's XGlobals loader and script string list loader: the zone prefix before the asset array, walked with their tables
